question.zh-CN: 什么身体适合什么任务，如何平衡可达空间、运动能力、成本与可靠性？
question.en: Which body fits a task, balancing reach, mobility, cost and reliability?

problem.zh-CN: 在人类尺度空间中移动并操作。
problem.en: Move and manipulate in human-scale spaces.

research.zh-CN: 全身协调、平衡与跨形态迁移。
research.en: Whole-body coordination, balance and morphology transfer.

industry.zh-CN: 跌倒防护、热管理、维修与稳定交付。
industry.en: Fall protection, thermal management, service and reliable delivery.

compare.zh-CN: 持续负载、工作空间、故障恢复时间。
compare.en: Sustained payload, workspace and recovery time.

problem.zh-CN: 把导航、站位和双臂操作连成任务。
problem.en: Connect navigation, positioning and bimanual work.

research.zh-CN: 基座与手臂联合规划、长时程策略。
research.en: Joint base-arm planning and long-horizon policies.

industry.zh-CN: 底盘定位、升降结构、工位接口。
industry.en: Base localization, lifts and workstation interfaces.

compare.zh-CN: 定位误差、操作成功率、任务周期。
compare.en: Positioning error, task success and cycle time.

problem.zh-CN: 在楼梯、坡面和不平地面移动。
problem.en: Traverse stairs, slopes and uneven ground.

research.zh-CN: 地形适应、视觉运动控制。

industry.zh-CN: 巡检载荷、防护与续航管理。

compare.zh-CN: 地形边界、载荷工况、任务续航。
compare.en: Terrain envelope, payload conditions and mission endurance.

name.zh-CN: 固定工业与协作机械臂

problem.zh-CN: 在受限工位完成重复或柔性操作。
problem.en: Perform repetitive or flexible work in constrained cells.

research.zh-CN: 精细操作、力控与技能迁移。
research.en: Fine manipulation, force control and skill transfer.

industry.zh-CN: 节拍、重复定位、工装和集成维护。
industry.en: Throughput, repeatability, tooling and integration service.

compare.zh-CN: 工作空间、重复精度、力控接口。

problem.zh-CN: 降低实验、教学和复现门槛。
problem.en: Lower barriers to experiments, teaching and reproduction.

research.zh-CN: 可复现本体、低成本策略学习。
research.en: Reproducible bodies and low-cost policy learning.

industry.zh-CN: 易装配、备件、文档与开发支持。
industry.en: Assembly, spares, documentation and developer support.

compare.zh-CN: 物料成本、装配步骤、开放范围。
compare.en: Bill of materials, assembly process and openness scope.

name.zh-CN: 专用、柔性与可穿戴本体

problem.zh-CN: 适配狭窄、柔性或人体耦合任务。
problem.en: Fit confined, compliant or human-coupled tasks.

research.zh-CN: 形态设计、人机动力学与柔性建模。
research.en: Morphology design, human-robot dynamics and soft modeling.

industry.zh-CN: 任务专用结构、佩戴舒适与维护。

compare.zh-CN: 适用人群或场景、力学边界、验证条件。
compare.en: Intended users or settings, mechanical limits and validation conditions.

name.zh-CN: 移动底盘与模块化载体

problem.zh-CN: 为感知、运输和操作提供移动载体。
problem.en: Provide mobile carriers for sensing, transport and manipulation.

research.zh-CN: 运动学、地形适配与任务模块协同。
research.en: Kinematics, terrain adaptation and task-module coordination.

industry.zh-CN: 载荷接口、导航接入、供电与车体维护。
industry.en: Payload interfaces, navigation integration, power and base service.

compare.zh-CN: 载荷工况、转弯半径、供电和安装接口。
compare.en: Payload conditions, turning radius, power and mounting interfaces.

problem.zh-CN: 在固定工位研究或执行双臂与上身操作。
problem.en: Study or execute bimanual and upper-body work at fixed stations.

research.zh-CN: 臂间协调、操作空间与示教学习。
research.en: Arm coordination, manipulation workspace and learning from demonstrations.

industry.zh-CN: 立柱、固定结构、工位适配和末端配置。
industry.en: Columns, fixtures, workstation integration and end effectors.

compare.zh-CN: 有效自由度、操作范围、负载与固定条件。
compare.en: Effective degrees of freedom, workspace, load and mounting conditions.
